Expecting MPs to vote in 'lockstep' is common across all parties in Canadian politics. Each party has their own Party Whip whose job is to do just that. Justin Trudeau himself recently caused a stir by mandating that all Liberal MPs would be expected vote in support of abortion rights, regardless of personal conscience. I'm far more concerned about the government's treatment of its citizens than fellow politicians when it comes to scary words like 'authoritarian'.

Inter-office policies on any kind of external communication are common to all government offices, from environment to the treasury, and have been under every government.
